tone.target: dry Bo Diddley rhythm chime with maraca-like drive
tone.profile: dry Bo Diddley rhythm chime with maraca-like drive

rig.name: Bo Diddley - Who Do You Love_ - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain a tight rhythm feel.
Provide a subtle, percussive edge-of-breakup and punch without sounding like heavy overdrive.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate the light grit of an old combo amp rather than a dedicated OD pedal.

alternatives.model: Green OD (for a slightly more vintage, less aggressive touch)

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and focused on rhythm articulation; no dedicated distortion needed.
Simulate the clean, bright, and punchy sound of a small Fender/Vox combo amp.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the closest model to a classic American rhythm setup (like a Princeton or Tweed).

alternatives.model: Silver Twin (if more clean headroom is desired)

blocks.purpose: Provide a focused, dry, and articulate sound suitable for rhythm work.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is the best fit for simulating a small, punchy combo cabinet.

alternatives.model: Foxy 2x12 (if a slightly more British edge is acceptable)

blocks.purpose: Enhance the raw midrange bite and percussive attack required for the Bo Diddley rhythm.
blocks.gap: Manual EQ adjustment is necessary to achieve the specific 'midrange punch' characteristic of the genre.

blocks.purpose: No wah needed; the focus must remain on dry rhythm and percussive attack.
Avoid lush effects; Chorus is too distracting and would muddy the dry rhythm.
Keep the sound dry and focused on the immediate rhythm pattern.
Provide the absolute minimum amount of ambience to prevent the tone from sounding sterile, while remaining dry.
blocks.gap: The reverb must be kept extremely low (Room setting) to avoid 'big reverb' and maintain percussive clarity.

alternatives.model: Plate (if a slightly more controlled decay is preferred)

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the small combo amp sound.

proposals.reason: Better captures the punchy, dry sound of a vintage combo amp.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in the low mids.
